basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old arcade game enthusiast based in Denver, Colorado. By day, I work as a software engineer, and by night, I indulge in my love for retro video games and explore the latest in MMORPGs. I have a soft spot for anything involving dragons and medieval themes. I often travel between Denver and Bentonville for work and enjoy exploring new gaming arcades whenever possible. When I'm not gaming, you can find me hiking the Rockies or enjoying a quiet evening with my partner and our two cats. My online hours are mostly in the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I grew up in the early '90s, spending countless hours at local arcades. This passion led me to pursue a degree in computer science, focusing on game development. Over the years, I've combined my love for gaming with my profession, developing indie games and contributing to open-source projects related to retro gaming emulation.
